title: Campus Infrastructure Overview
content:
According to the official Infrastructure page, DAVIET campus facilities include:

- Core Block: Applied Sciences & IT requirements; labs for ECE and Electrical Engineering; Computer Centre and computer labs.
- R & D Block: advanced labs (Light Wave Technology, Robotics, Nano Technology); Principal’s Office; Administrative & Accounts Offices; classrooms; e-lecture theatres; electronics labs.
- e-Education / computer-focused block: specialized computer labs, e-classrooms with LCD projectors and sound systems, drawing halls, tutorial rooms, departmental offices.
- Post Graduate block: Convention Hall, classrooms and offices; supports PG students and Mechanical & Civil Engineering offices/labs.
- Material Science Block: workshops (carpentry, fitting, welding, machine tools, foundry) and Mechanical/Civil labs; Metrology & Mechanical Measurement lab in collaboration with Mitutoyo Corporation (Japan).
- Knowledge Centre: Central Library, bank, ATM and related facilities.
- Lala Chanchal Dass DAVIET Auditorium: centrally air-conditioned, seating capacity about 1200; cultural and multipurpose use; indoor badminton and table tennis mentioned.
- Convention Hall (PG block): audio-visual aids for seminars and expert talks.
